text.tspan: Self-reported life satisfaction vs. GDP per capita2011 to 2025
Self-reported life satisfaction is measured on a scale ranging from 0-10, where 10 is the highest possible life
satisfaction. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: Wellbeing Research Centre (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Note: GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data is unavailable, the closest value within 5 years is shown
